game_concept: A puzzle set in The Kingdom – Watchtower Ring, towers along the town wall: the herald must handle bandits while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Print Probe: Use print-style probes to reveal hidden variable values before bandits act.
theme: The Kingdom – Watchtower Ring: towers along the town wall
core_gameplay_loop: In Watchtower Ring, repeat each round: Use print-style probes to reveal hidden variable values before bandits act. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the shield value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the town gate using at most 10 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The town gate reached with actions_used <= 10.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 10 before the town gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Print Probe
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Print Probe' (Week 1 slot 13), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Watchtower Ring'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how shield changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bandits in Watchtower Ring.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The town gate reached with actions_used <= 10.
